purpose: Addendum to holdout_sel1m_train8m_lr3e-3_v1, fixed before training: standard ParT on train8m_head with start LR 1e-2 (one member, otherwise as sel1m_train8m_standard_part), because the best member so far had the highest start LR tested, 3e-3. The standard ParT 3e-3 checkpoint is re-evaluated as the reference. The standard ParT result on 8M becomes the one of the 1e-3, 3e-3 and 1e-2 checkpoints with the best sel1m_tail value; the holdout does not choose. Pair: the 1e-2 checkpoint against the 3e-3 one.
